description: Figure 3, titled “Dataset Statistics,” is a bar chart that visually compares the distribution of prompts across different writing genres and constraint types within the ESSAYBENCH dataset. The horizontal axis lists five essay genres: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, Expository, and Persuasive. The vertical axis represents the count of prompts, ranging from 0 to 200 in increments of 50. For each genre, two adjacent bars are displayed: a light gray bar labeled “Open” (denoting Open-Ended sets) and a dark gray bar labeled “Cons.” (denoting Constrained sets). Across all genres, the Open-ended prompts consistently outnumber the Constrained ones. Specifically, Argumentative has approximately 180 Open and 100 Cons. prompts; Narrative has about 160 Open and 80 Cons.; Descriptive has roughly 140 Open and 70 Cons.; Expository has around 130 Open and 60 Cons.; and Persuasive has approximately 120 Open and 50 Cons. The chart visually emphasizes the predominance of open-ended prompts across all genres, with the difference between Open and Cons. prompts being most pronounced in Argumentative and least in Persuasive. The legend is embedded in the caption, clarifying that “Open” and “Cons.” refer to Open-Ended and Constrained sets, respectively.
